analysis.rationale: Revenue and PAT grew 15% and 36% YoY respectively, with EBITDA margin expansion of 123 bps. The company also completed the acquisition of Kumarakom Resort and signed 8 new hotels, indicating strong growth momentum.
analysis.summary: ITC Hotels reported consolidated revenue of ₹936 Cr (up 15% YoY), EBITDA of ₹292 Cr (up 19%), and PAT of ₹182 Cr (up 36%) for Q1 FY27, with strong RevPAR growth and accelerated asset-right expansion.
